name: Danganronpa Blood of Despair
source:
Our protagonist is trapped on an unknown island with 19 other people, all equally confused, and a Bear is back with a new game to kill. Can we survive?

[Edited from [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/DRBOD/419811]GameJolt[/url]]
translation:
主角和另外19個人被困在一座陌生的島上，誰也弄不清是怎麼回事。那隻熊又回來了，還帶來了一場全新的殺人遊戲。我們能活下去嗎？

［編譯自[url=https://gamejolt.com/games/DRBOD/419811]GameJolt[/url]］
